summary.text: Zach Hall is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 5-Position 1, a seat he was appointed to in June 2025, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
He is a former Issaquah City Councilmember.

paragraphs.text: Zach Hall is a lifelong Issaquah resident who served six years on the Issaquah City Council and chaired the Eastside Fire & Rescue Board of Directors, according to the House Democrats' biography.

He previously worked as a legislative assistant in the House and holds undergraduate and graduate degrees from the University of Washington, including a Master of Public Administration from the Evans School of Public Policy & Governance.
Hall was appointed to fill a vacant House seat in June 2025, and Ballotpedia gives his date of taking office as June 3, 2025.
He serves on the Environment & Energy, Local Government and Transportation committees.
